name: @hang/api
description: TypeScript backend server for Hang using tRPC, Drizzle, and Cloudflare Workers

scripts.check: bun run build && tsc --project tsconfig.test.json && biome check
scripts.build: bun run types && tsc --noEmit false --emitDeclarationOnly --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile dist/api.tsbuildinfo
scripts.types: for package in clock pattern auth; do bun run --cwd ../moq/js/$package tsc --project tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile dist/hang.tsbuildinfo || exit $?; done
